title: Install checkpoint: resume after the last verified step
subtitle: Installer checkpoint design record (ADR-0046). Both installers, on Windows, Linux, macOS and Azure Cloud Shell. The checkpoint says where a rerun starts; a live Azure read decides whether a step is skipped.

groups.title: Operator side - one checkpoint per checkout, with no tokens, keys or connection strings
Apply - the first write follows the confirmed summary (ADR-0032)
Resume - live Azure state decides; the checkpoint only says where to start

nodes.title: 1 - Guided flow
lines: [[flowcall]] runs the installer; a rerun of the flow's first phase resumes it.
[[record]] keeps applied values only.
A refusal reaches the flow as an exception.

nodes.title: 2 - Two installers, one contract
lines: [[open]] in [[ps]].
[[shopen]] in [[sh]].
Neither resumes the other's checkpoint.

nodes.title: 3 - Per-user state directory
lines: [[location]]: [[statedir]] when set, [[clouddrive]] in Cloud Shell, else LOCALAPPDATA or XDG state.
[[storecheck]] refuses a store outside the home or one another account can alter.

nodes.title: 4 - Commit point
lines: [[save]] and [[shsave]] record the binding, the answers and the lock.
Another tenant, subscription, resource group or gateway refuses.

nodes.title: 5 - Name before create
lines: [[register]] records [[deployname]] before [[main]] is deployed.
No second main.bicep deployment starts while one runs.

nodes.title: 6 - Receipts by id
lines: [[groups]] records each Entra group's id and whether this run created it.
A resume reads each group by id; by name only the one listed group with the name's length counts, and a failed read creates nothing.

nodes.title: 7 - Verify before a skip
lines: [[skip]] and [[shskip]] skip a step only on a live read.
[[azread]]: present skips, absent reruns, inconclusive refuses (an idempotent step reruns).

nodes.title: 8 - Recorded deployment
lines: [[gateway]]: running waits, succeeded gives outputs, failed or canceled reruns.
Read-backs run before a PowerShell deployment; bash redeploys only a gateway its own run created.

nodes.title: 9 - Azure Cloud Shell
lines: Without clouddrive: the session's $HOME, a warning and the full resume command.
[[cloudline]]: the 20-minute idle limit before a wait over 60 s.

notice: The installers add no Azure resource or identity: the live reads use the operator's Azure CLI sign-in. The checkpoint is a file on the operator's machine; in Cloud Shell it is in clouddrive when storage is mounted, otherwise in the session's $HOME, with the full resume command printed.
